This record separates **performed investigation checks** from **future migration acceptance tests**. It does not certify that any baseline has trained successfully on the requested large models.

**Performed checks, 2026-09-16.** Reproducible outputs are in [audit_results.json](evidence/audit_results.json), generated by [audit_code.py](audit_code.py). Public model/package metadata and hashes are in [public_metadata.json](evidence/public_metadata.json), collected by [collect_metadata.py](collect_metadata.py). The scripts operate on the repositories without editing their training files.

| Check | Result | Scope / limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Git origins, commits and status | Four intended remotes; clean working trees | Exact commits are listed in the report and JSON; google-research is sparse |
| Python syntax / AST | 106 relevant Python files parsed; zero SyntaxErrors | Python 3.12.7 host parser; several pre-existing invalid-escape SyntaxWarnings in evaluation helpers. Syntax success does not verify imports or runtime behavior. |
| Runtime detection | Python 3.12.7; torch 2.6.0+cpu; no CUDA build/GPU | Not the proposed Python 3.11/CUDA training environment |
| Qwen checkpoint config retrieval | Both revision-pinned configs and generation configs downloaded | No model weights loaded |
| Qwen tokenizers | Byte-identical tokenizer JSON; complete token maps equal; 151,643 base entries, 151,669 total entries; both model heads specified as 151,936 | Strong tokenizer/config evidence; actual weight/head shape still a later model-loading check |
| Qwen separator collision | Token ID 65535 maps to `ĠgroupName` | Demonstrates the hard-coded legacy separator is a valid normal token |
| Llama metadata | Public API IDs/revisions retrieved; raw tokenizer/config access returned HTTP 401 | Full Llama mapping and exact HF configs unverified; public Meta registry separately supports 128,256 head vocab |
| Proposed dependency metadata | No contradictions in 27 direct comparisons among selected core/optional pins; proposed Python accepted where Requires-Python is provided | 114 other active requirement entries remain unresolved; no environment installation, full resolver or pip check |
| KD soft CE vs forward KL | CPU losses 2.956194 and 0.947531; max student-gradient difference about 1.12e-8 | Confirms equal optimization gradient on a controlled finite example, not equal numerical loss |
| ABKD analytic limits | Alpha=1,beta=0 and alpha=0,beta=1 matched forward/reverse KL in probe; general .1/.8 finite; equal-distribution loss about 5.96e-7 | Small FP32 CPU tensors; no BF16/full-vocabulary stress test or GPU training |
| DistiLLM nonadaptive threshold | Isolated expression reproduced TypeError for None × float | Static branch analysis ties it to KD/GKD training; full launcher was not run |
| SKD student no-grad | AST locates training student forward at 781 within no-grad block 497–819; CPU no-grad result has requires_grad=False | Validation's separate no-grad scope is expected; the training scope is the defect |
| Legacy binary conversion | -1→65535 as uint16; -1→4294967295 as uint32; ID128000→62464 as uint16 | Reproduces data corruption/mismatched separator without large datasets |
| Legacy sampler alignment | With input `[4,5,6,7,0,0]`, generated labels are `[-100,-100,6,7,-100,-100]` | Executed the unchanged sampler class against a deterministic fake generator; demonstrates same-position targets when loop uses unshifted logits |
| SKD JS direction | Source helper 0.235570 versus conventional JS 0.171674 on the same tensors | Default SKD uses KL; only its JS alternative is implicated |
| Target API source inspection | Transformers 4.51.3 Trainer accepts/passes `num_items_in_batch`, log accepts `start_time`; top-level AdamW/default_chat_template absent; TRL 0.9.6 required helpers present | Source-backed migration requirements; not an executed full Trainer import/training test |

**Primary external evidence.** Downloaded source snapshots and hashes are indexed in [upstream/sources.json](evidence/upstream/sources.json). Target Trainer behavior was inspected in [Transformers 4.51.3 Trainer source](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v4.51.3/src/transformers/trainer.py), and the retained helper symbols in [TRL 0.9.6 utilities](https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/v0.9.6/trl/trainer/utils.py). Model and package facts are linked next to the relevant claims in the report/configuration documents. No untrusted model weights or dataset code were executed.

**Not performed.** Full dependency resolution/installation on Linux, CUDA/FlashAttention/DeepSpeed compilation, downloads of the large teacher/student weights, Llama token-map equality checks, complete loss/gradient equivalence for every method, actual-checkpoint smoke training, distributed validation, memory profiling, checkpoint-resume validation and task evaluation. These are explicitly planned in [codex_modification_plan.md](codex_modification_plan.md). The public metadata checks and CPU probes cannot substitute for them.

**Current open experiment choices.** Hardware/OS, task/dataset/revision, metric and budget were not supplied. The Llama shorthand has been represented literally as original Llama 3 8B plus Llama 3.2 1B; Llama 3.1 8B and Instruct variants remain alternatives. The report is complete as an investigation with these limitations; the future experiment runner must keep launch gates pending until its required fields are resolved.

To repeat the evidence collection on this workstation:

```powershell
Set-Location G:\Baseline
python check\collect_metadata.py
python check\audit_code.py
```

Collection retrieves current API revisions, so a later rerun may update the evidence snapshot. Archive the present files first when preserving this exact investigation. No training-environment changes are required by the document itself; the audit script depends on the already observed host torch/NumPy/tokenizers/packaging libraries.
